description: This Java source file defines an abstract utility class 'StatusCodeMapper' for mapping HTTP and AMQP status codes and error conditions to custom exceptions related to service invocation errors. It includes methods to determine if a status code indicates success, and to generate appropriate exceptions based on either generic results, registration results, specific status codes, or AMQP error conditions.

classes.name: StatusCodeMapper
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to map HTTP and AMQP error/status codes to specific service invocation exception instances.

methods.name: isSuccessful
methods.description: Checks if a given status code represents a successful invocation (HTTP 200-299).

methods.name: from(RequestResponseResult)
methods.description: Creates a ServiceInvocationException based on a RequestResponseResult object.

methods.name: from(RegistrationResult)
methods.description: Creates a ServiceInvocationException based on a RegistrationResult object.

methods.name: from(int, String)
methods.description: Creates a ServiceInvocationException from a status code and a detail message, mapping specific ranges to exceptions.

methods.name: from(ErrorCondition)
methods.description: Creates a ServiceInvocationException from an AMQP ErrorCondition object.

methods.name: from(Symbol, String)
methods.description: Creates a ServiceInvocationException based on an AMQP Symbol condition and description.
